summary: Phase 12 (Cloudflare R2 object storage) + Phase 10/11 regression verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 NEW e2e upload tests PASS (test_phase12_e2e_uploads.py) + 13/13 prior Phase 10/11/12 tests PASS = 20/20 green. Verified: VIP label can create release draft and upload a 3000x3000 PNG cover that lands in R2 under cover/{release_id}.png; /api/files/{key} 302-redirects to presigned R2 URL containing X-Amz-Signature; downloaded bytes match upload. Ticket attachment (PDF, purpose='general') uploads to ticket/ key prefix and also 302-redirects properly. /api/auth/forgot-password returns ok:true and backend log confirms '[EMAIL] sent to=superadmin@rilismusik.com subject=Reset password RILIS MUSIK id=sent' (Phase 11 SMTP live). /api/files/smoketest/does-not-exist returns 404. /api/cms/mda/preview streams valid PDF bytes (>2KB, starts with %PDF-) in-memory with no disk write (Phase 12). /api/royalty/admin/imports list returns 200 with status field per row. Frontend Playwright smoke: super-admin can load /admin/royalty (118 status badges rendered in 'Pending Review' state with table of periode/kurs/revenue/lines/status), /admin/cms loads with Hero/Benefits/Pricing/FAQ/SEO/Footer/Legal-Entity tabs. VIP demo label dashboard renders balance Rp 15.000.000, 3 releases, Annual tier — no broken images. /label/releases shows the TEST_R2_E2E draft created via API test alongside Cinta Sederhana/Kota Mati/Symphony Kecil — all 2 cover images loaded (naturalWidth>0), proving R2 + disk-fallback file serving works through the UI. Zero regressions from R2 migration.

issues: MDA Preview trigger button is not present on the Hero/General tabs — likely hidden under the Legal Entity tab. Endpoint /api/cms/mda/preview works fine (returns valid PDF) but discoverability of the trigger is low. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L50-69 serve_file hybrid handler: R2-first then disk-fallback is the correct migration strategy — old uploaded files stay reachable. TTL logic (7d for cover/landing, 1h for others) is sensible. One minor concern: head_object() is called on every cold request which adds an extra R2 round-trip; for hot covers, consider caching {key -> exists} for ~60s in a small TTL dict if traffic warrants.

routes/releases.py upload_cover (L224-258): file.read() into memory is fine for 3000x3000 JPG/PNG (typically 2-5 MB), but upload_audio (L261-284) correctly uses upload_fileobj for streaming multipart — good. Note: storage_service has guess_content_type helper used in tickets.py but not here (releases.py hardcodes content_type) — minor inconsistency, not a bug.

routes/tickets.py upload_attachment (L79-118) cleanly branches on purpose='audio'/'cover'/general with proper validation. Cover branch enforces 3000x3000 strictly (img.size != (3000,3000)) but releases.py only enforces >=3000x3000 + square — minor inconsistency that may confuse users uploading replacement covers through tickets vs releases. Consider unifying.

Phase 12 endpoint /api/files/{path} returns 404 for unknown keys correctly (verified). Path traversal guard (L65-66) checks resolved path is under UPLOAD_DIR — secure against ../ escapes for the disk-fallback path.
All upload routes properly use require_label/require_admin/get_current_user dependencies and check label ownership / release status before allowing upload. RBAC is consistent.
Phase 11 forgot-password is best-effort (returns ok:true even on SMTP failure) per the credentials.md note — verified the log line '[EMAIL] sent to=...' confirms actual SMTP send, not a swallow.

Phase 10 RoyaltyImport page renders 'Pending Review' badges via data-testid='royalty-status-*' — 118 visible. Progress bars (role=progressbar) returned 0 in this run because no import is currently in 'processing' state; the progress UI is conditional on status==='processing' and would only render during a live import — by design.

Cover upload in releases.py L249: 'except ImportError: pass' silently skips dimension validation if Pillow is missing. In production this is reasonable since Pillow is in requirements.txt, but consider logging a warning so we know if image validation was bypassed.

Uses pytest + requests; needs only REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. To run: `pytest backend/tests/test_phase12_e2e_uploads.py -v`. SMTP log line proving Phase 11 working: grep '[EMAIL] sent to=' /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log. R2 endpoints: cover/{release_id}.{ext}, audio/{track_id}.wav, ticket/ticket_{uuid}.{ext}, mda/{label_id}.pdf (when registered). Disk fallback at /app/backend/uploads/ still works for legacy files. rca of the issue: Single test failure during initial run: test_super_admin_royalty_imports_list hit /api/admin/royalty/imports (404) — wrong path. Correct path is /api/royalty/admin/imports because royalty_r router has prefix='/royalty' (server.py L83 mounts under /api). Fixed by updating the URL; test now passes. No production code defect.
